title: [Subcontracting] (Bug: 638998) Add extensibility to Subcontracting app for IT partner migration
summary: The Subcontracting app gains integration events for report objects to support partner migration from legacy Italian subcontracting features, and a redundant customization restriction is removed from the Subcontractor Price table.
key_points: Added integration events to Subc. Create Transf. Order report mirroring legacy report 12152 functionality
Added OnAfterInsertTransferHeader and OnBeforeShowDocument events to Subc. Create SubCReturnOrder report matching legacy report 12153
Removed redundant AllowInCustomizations property from Subcontractor Price table
All new events use IntegrationEvent(false, false) following app conventions
Changes are additive with low risk and no alteration to existing control flow
quote: The new W1 Subcontracting app was missing extensibility points that Italian partners depend on when migrating from the legacy IT BaseApp subcontracting objects.
